description: Navigate to a URL and return a compact accessibility snapshot with @eN refs. Refs like @e1, @e2 can be passed directly to the 'act' tool — no CSS selectors needed. Snapshots are ~200-500 tokens (vs 15,000 with Playwright MCP).

autoRetry.description: Auto-retry with stealth escalation when blocked. Default: true.

maxRetryLevel.description: Max escalation level (0-5). Level 3+ rotates session. Default: 3.

waitUntil.description: Wait strategy. Use networkidle for SPAs.

name: navigate
title: Navigate & Snapshot
